title: age
summary: A public encryption tool and Go library designed around small explicit keys and composable file encryption.
intended_users: People and software that need focused file encryption and decryption workflows.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Provide modern file encryption with a deliberately narrow, composable interface.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: The public documentation contrasts the format and interface with more configurable legacy encryption workflows.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Use explicit recipient and identity abstractions with a small file-format and command boundary.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: A narrow interface intentionally omits many configuration choices and cannot eliminate endpoint compromise.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Review committed parsing, encryption, negative-case, compatibility, and command tests without claiming they were executed.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Revisit format and recipient boundaries when new recipient types or compatibility constraints cannot fit the stable interfaces.

testing_strategy: Committed Go tests cover APIs, parsing, recipients, file format, command behavior, and negative cases; Finch does not execute them.
security_threat: The project addresses unauthorized file disclosure and tampering through authenticated encryption and explicit recipient identities; endpoint control and operational key handling remain outside static verification.
production_limitation: Static review does not validate cryptographic correctness, runtime behavior, releases, platform integration, or user key-management practices.
technical_debt: Treat the pinned repository as public holdout evidence, not as a security certification or endorsement.
track_alignment_explanation: Encryption and concrete protection against unauthorized disclosure are the primary product purpose.

ai_disclosure.purposes: No claim is made about upstream AI use; this holdout submission narrative was prepared for calibration without maintainer input.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: A human reviewer froze the reference range before model inference.
